description: Find physical products and compare prices from shops in Greece with BestPrice. Ask what to buy for your needs and budget, search for a specific model, compare current non-sponsored offers with shipping and availability, or check up to 180 days of price history. Shipping that cannot be verified is shown as unknown, not free. BestPrice links take you to product pages where you can review shops before choosing whether to buy. The plugin is read-only: it cannot place orders, add items to a cart, or complete checkout. No BestPrice account is required.

interface.longDescription: Find physical products and compare prices from shops in Greece with BestPrice. Ask what to buy for your needs and budget, search for a specific model, compare current non-sponsored offers with shipping and availability, or check up to 180 days of price history. Shipping that cannot be verified is shown as unknown, not free. BestPrice links take you to product pages where you can review shops before choosing whether to buy. The plugin is read-only: it cannot place orders, add items to a cart, or complete checkout. No BestPrice account is required. Open the native shopping workspace to search products, compare offers and view price history. Optional account linking is reserved for price-drop event subscriptions; it does not grant access to your account history or orders.

review.commerce_description: Read-only comparison of physical products from Greek stores, with links to BestPrice. No checkout, payment, cart, ordering or direct merchant transaction.

publication.release_notes: Native shopping workspace with global and thread entrypoints, preserved shopping cards, task-specific inputs, and durable OAuth-bound price-drop Events. Shopping remains anonymous and read-only.
